MARKING SCHEME
MANDARIN CHINESE — GRADE 10
SECTION A: [30 MARKS]
I. PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS & LISTENING (10 Marks)
 1. Blending: (1 mk each)
 (a) lǎoshī (Teacher)
 (b) yīshēng (Doctor)
 (c) túshūguǎn (Library)
 2. Tone Discrimination: (1 mk each)
 (a) mā ma (1st tone)
 (b) bà ba (4th tone)
 (c) gē ge (1st tone)
 3. Listening Cues: (2 mks each)
 (a) Rìcháng (If the sentence described a daily school activity).
 (b) Wàichū (If the sentence described visiting a park/attraction).
II. GRAMMAR & STRUCTURE (20 Marks)
 1. Measure Words: (1.25 mks each)
 (a) 口 (kǒu) — Used for family members.
 (b) 本 (běn) — Used for books.
 (c) 只 (zhī) — Used for animals like lions.
 (d) 个 (gè) — General classifier for people.
 2. Sentence Structure: (2.5 mks each)
 (a) 我们昨天去看了博物馆吗？ (Wǒmen zuótiān qù kànle bówùguǎn ma?)
 (b) 电视在桌子上。 (Diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.)
 3. Adverbs of Degree: (1.5 mks each - 0.5 for spelling, 1 for context)
 (b) 比 (bǐ)
 (c) 非常 (fēicháng)
 4. Demonstrative Pronouns: (2.5 mks each)
 (a) 那 (nà) — Refers to "there" (far).
 (b) 这 (zhè) — Refers to an item being eaten (close).
SECTION B: [50 MARKS]
III. NAMING FROM PICTURES (10 Marks) (Accept Pinyin with tones or Characters)
 1. 超市 (Chāoshì) - Supermarket (2 mks)
 2. 医生 (Yīshēng) - Doctor (2 mks)
 3. 厨房 (Chúfáng) - Kitchen (2 mks)
 4. 长颈鹿 (Chángjǐnglù) - Giraffe (2 mks)
 5. 八点一刻 (Bā diǎn yī kè) - 8:15 (2 mks)
IV. READING COMPREHENSION (15 Marks)
 1. 四口人 (4 people). (2 mks)
 2. 他是医生，在医院工作 (He is a doctor, works in a hospital). (2 mks)
 3. 因为数学太难了 (Because math is too difficult). (3 mks)
 4. 内罗毕国家公园 (Nairobi National Park). (3 mks)
 5. True/False: (1 mk each + 2 bonus for all correct)
 (a) 错 (Cuò) - Mother is a teacher.
 (b) 对 (Duì) - Saw giraffes.
 (c) 错 (Cuò) - Thinks it's hard, not interesting.
V. DIALOGUE COMPLETION (10 Marks)
 多少 (duōshǎo) (2 mks)
 贵 (guì) (2 mks)
 便宜 (piányí) (2 mks)
 件 (jiàn) — Measure word for clothes (2 mks)
 (Accept logical variations like 我要这个). (2 mks)
VI. WRITING & ORTHOGRAPHY (15 Marks)
 1. Stroke Order (家): (5 Marks)
 Award marks for correct top-to-bottom
 Download and left-to-right
 this and other FREEsequence (Roof radical
 revision materials first, then the "pig" radical
 underneath).
2. Creative Writing: (10 Marks)
 Relevance: Did they mention school time, subjects, and locations? (4 mks)
 Grammar: Correct use of S+V+O and Time words. (3 mks)
 Characters/Pinyin Accuracy: Legibility and correct tones. (3 mks)
